insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured + Booster+ Sum Insured + Safeguard/Safeguard+ Sum Insured (exact amounts as per Policy Schedule)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: We don’t limit your choice. Choose the room you like, but choose judiciously to protect your Sum Insured.
great.explanation: You can select any room category without limits on room rent, giving you full flexibility and no risk of claim reduction due to room type.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: Sum Insured will be utilized as per following sequence in event of any claim: 1. Base Sum Insured 2. Booster+ Sum Insured 3. Safeguard/Safeguard+ Sum Insured
great.explanation: Additional Sum Insured layers activate after the base Sum Insured is exhausted, increasing your coverage for higher medical expenses without extra purchase.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: Enjoy unlimited Sum Insured. The first paid claim in the life of the policy triggers ReAssure “Forever”. Once Triggered it stays for life, provided that the policy is renewed without break.
great.explanation: After your first claim, your Sum Insured is restored unlimited times for future claims as long as you renew continuously, ensuring ongoing full coverage.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a Pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 36 months from policy start, which is within the standard 2–4 year industry range, requiring a 3-year wait before claims.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
good.explanation: Certain specified illnesses and procedures are excluded for 24 months from inception, matching the industry standard 2-year waiting period.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident, provided the same are covered.
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered during the first 30 days except for accidents, which is standard practice, so new illnesses within the first month cannot be claimed.

bad.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
bad.quote: We will pay expenses incurred on consultations, medicines, physiotherapy, diagnostic tests for 60 days before the date of admission and 180 days after date of discharge
bad.explanation: Post-hospitalization expenses are covered for up to 180 days after discharge, which meets but does not exceed the standard limit, offering limited follow-up care coverage.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Co-Payment: It is the percentage of admissible claim amount You would have to bear, Rest we will pay.
bad.explanation: The policy includes a co-payment clause, meaning you must pay a portion of each claim, which is less favorable compared to no co-pay plans.

unclear.name: No Claim Bonus
unclear.quote: Cumulative Bonus means any increase or addition in the Sum Insured granted by the insurer without an associated increase in premium
unclear.explanation: The policy mentions cumulative bonus but does not clarify the rate, cap, or if it resets after claims, so you should check your Policy Schedule for details.

unclear.name: Consumables
unclear.quote: Claim Safeguard: We will cover non-payable items mentioned in ‘List I – Expenses not covered’ of Annexure I’... Claim Safeguard+: We will cover non-payable items mentioned in ‘List I,II,III,IV of Annexure I’.
unclear.explanation: Coverage for consumables depends on optional add-ons and it is unclear if they are included by default, so confirm your plan details.

unclear.name: Restore Limit
unclear.quote: Maximum amount ReAssure+ pays for any single claim is up to Base Sum Insured.
unclear.explanation: Although restore benefit is unlimited, each claim is capped at the base Sum Insured and conditions vary; check your Policy Schedule for exact terms.

unclear.name: Cashless Network
unclear.quote: Cashless claim facility is available at our network hospitals ONLY. As list of network hospitals is dynamic, for the latest list, refer to our website www.nivabupa.com.
unclear.explanation: Cashless claims are available only at network hospitals, but the policy does not specify how many hospitals are included; check the insurer’s website for current details.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
